Large Print Sudoku

99 Bold and Easy Puzzles for Adults and Seniors

99 easy sudoku puzzles printed one per page in extra-large, bold type. No squinting, no cramped grids, no frustration – just pure, relaxing logic from the first square to the last.

Who it's for

The perfect gift for parents, grandparents, and anyone who loves puzzles but hates small print. Great for quiet mornings, waiting rooms, travel, and winding down before bed.

Grab a pencil, settle into a comfortable chair, and enjoy sudoku the way it should be – big, bold, and easy.

Look inside

Questions

How do you play sudoku?

Fill the grid so that every row, every column and every 3 x 3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 exactly once.

Do I ever have to guess?

No. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and you can reach it by logic alone.

Are the answers included?

Yes. Full solutions are at the back.
